vision_root_unavailable.description: A vision root's model listing cannot be used: the root or its models directory is unavailable. actingd's startup listing, its check-config and vision-provider-check refuse the root with it.

vision_models_empty.description: A vision root's model listing cannot be used: the models directory holds no model folder.

vision_model_folder_invalid.description: A vision root's model listing cannot be used: a model folder breaks the folder rule (check-config and vision-provider-check refuse it; startup records it). Startup records each such folder with its path and, when it fits the name rule, its model_name.

vision_gpu_unavailable.description: The configured GPU execution provider cannot be used (Workflow #407 GPU-1, design rd-1031/perf-407/design-gpu1.md section 2.5): with gpu_fallback cpu the work goes on on the CPU, with gpu_fallback refuse OCR requests fail. gpu_unavailable_reason says why: no DXGI adapter has the configured identity or the adapters cannot be listed (adapter_missing), two or more physical adapters have it (adapter_ambiguous), only indirect-display, software or paravirtualized copies have it (adapter_not_physical), ort\DirectML.dll is missing (directml_library_missing) or off the runtime pin (directml_library_mismatch), ONNX Runtime refused to register the provider (provider_register_failed) or to build a session (session_build_failed), or a session's node placement could not be read (placement_unread). The OS failure or the ONNX Runtime status behind the reason, when there is one, is its caused_by link; stage says where it was found, model_name which model it concerns. Never another adapter than the configured one is used. Registered by GPU-1 A; first emitted by GPU-1 B2 and D.
